items.item_text: Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) OR Certificate of completion of a Medical Assistant training program.
BART or BLS at time of hire with commitment to get BART within six (6) months of hire date.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.

Experience working with Endocrinology, Diabetes, Osteoporosis/Bone Health, Gender Health and Thyroid Health.Strong interpersonal skills, exhibiting a professional demeanor to function effectively in diverse clinical/healthcare and community settings as well as possess the ability to communicate clearly and effectively (both through written and oratory methods) to diverse audiences.

Under direction of the supervision of a registered nurse in the assigned department reporting to the Practice Manager, performs a wide variety of patient care activities in support of clinic activity. This includes, rooming patients in-person and virtually; record vital statistics on patients as directed, including height, weight, blood pressure, heart rate and basal metabolic index, and track such measurements, ensuring each patient's privacy. Assist in patient triage processing, preparation and assistance with patient procedures, administering medications, point of care testing including glucose monitoring and HbA1c testing, collecting and preparing laboratory tests and specimens, and patient education.

The successful candidate will have experience working in a fast pace ambulatory specialty setting and have experience managing high volume Epic in-basket messages. Position requires initiative, ability to prioritize critical demands, attention to detail and the ability to work in a team environment, maintain positive relationships with patients, family members, other visitors, and fellow employees. Job standards are to be performed at the expert level. Other related duties as assigned.
Requires knowledge of universal precautions and proper use of body mechanics.
